scope: Read-only startup inspection; no games/results inspected for selection
correct_paths: Each worker creates two independent ScopedBot instances and closes them in finally; an atexit fallback covers registered scopes.
Worker game deadline is min(180 seconds, hard-cutoff remainder); scheduler stops starting games40seconds before hard cutoff.
Incomplete/crashed rows are recorded as errors and cannot make summary.complete true.
Only completed rows enter points; complete phase still requires all128 or64 planned rows.
Draw handling and per-side score_difference use SDK result.score; first-turn3000ms comes from SDK balance.json.
reported_boundary_risks: Parent KeyboardInterrupt wait(timeout30) has no TimeoutExpired recovery. Delayed cleanup can escape summary finalization.
Parent hard-cutoff loop has no second bounded kill/final-cleanup escalation if worker remains stuck while ignoring SIGTERM in cleanup.
Aggregate.forfeits includes opponent and candidate forfeits; use raw result.forfeit.team/cause for attribution.
